hypotheses_validated.claim: Verifier finding (major): Belady was not an upper bound with the GPU expert tier, because _Belady.initial() warm-started VRAM keys that run_cache never lets into the cache. Fixed: make_policy passes the VRAM mask to _Belady, which sets first[vram] = INF. Belady is again the exact optimum of the relaxed problem over the non-VRAM keys.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: Reproduced first: the verifier's CLI command gave lru-layer 68.2% > belady 63.4%; after the fix it gives belady 76.3% >= every online policy (ran). New tests (ran, pass): test_belady_bounds_online_policies_with_a_vram_tier, with 90 small schedules where Belady == the exhaustive optimum of the non-VRAM sub-problem plus 60 larger bound-only schedules, all online policies x 2 settings; and test_belady_upper_bound_with_the_gpu_expert_tier_through_simulate, with the verifier's repro and a tiny shape with exactly 7 VRAM slabs, 5 seeds x 2 configs. Both fail on the gen-2 code (scratch copy, ran).

hypotheses_validated.claim: Verifier finding (major): the LFU decay direction, the heat rescale, sampled-LFU victim choice and lru-layer partition sizing were untested. Now covered by exact tests: a hand-worked decay-1/2 vs decay-1 sequence; an exact-integer LFU reference over 1500-2000-token decay-1/2 traces (4-6 rescales, incl. a speculative schedule); a white-box check of the rescale threshold; the sampled victim distribution (uniform with 1 sample, plus the expected mixture with protected/held slabs); per-partition capacities with slots % L != 0 and per-layer hits on a cyclic trace.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: mutate.py on final code (ran): _LFU.tick (lines 487-496, seed 3) 0% (verifier) -> 88.9%. The verifier's second region set mapped to current lines (145-287, 389-418, 653-659, seed 5, 20 mutants) 65% -> 95.0%. Survivors are listed and argued equivalent in docs/SIMULATOR.md sec. 5. The tick mutants M0298/M0302/M0306 (inverted decay, rescale multiply, no rebuild) were also checked in scratch against the integer reference: all three detected.

hypotheses_validated.claim: Verifier finding (minor, perf): a cache full of protected prefetches made every admission scan the whole cache. Held (prefetched, unused) slabs are now kept out of the LRU order (stamped, merged back at admission position on release) and out of the LFU heap. The demand last resort is a policy method that takes the oldest/coldest held slab. LFU memoises a repeated REJECT under the same prot set, and sampled mode still draws the same samples. All of this is result-identical to gen 2.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: Scratch harness (ran) compares the gen-2 snapshot of cache.py with the final one: 53 100 random run_cache configurations, 6 seeds. Policies lru/lru-layer/lfu (4 settings incl. sampled)/pinned/lfu-pinned/belady; prefetch off and (0.5,0), (0.8,3), (0,6), (0.5,64), (1,0); spec windows, VRAM and cold keys, skip rank, warm-up. 0 differ, about 163 000 last-resort evictions exercised. Harness sensitivity: a deliberately wrong LRU last resort gave 138 of 3540 differing. In-repo: test_held_prefetch_rules_match_a_naive_model (150 random op sequences vs a naive timestamp model; >100 last resorts and >100 rejects) and test_a_cache_full_of_held_prefetches_rejects_without_a_scan. Doc sec. 7 example outputs and the sec. 8.6/8.7 rows reproduce byte-identically (ran). Timing for kimi-k2 Prefetch(0.5,64) at 4 GiB, gen 2 -> gen 3: LRU 50.6 -> 7.9 s, sampled LFU 44.1 -> 15.1 s, exact LFU 21.6 -> 7.0 s (same session, noisy).

hypotheses_validated.claim: Verifier minor findings fixed, each with a test that fails on gen-2 code (ran in a scratch copy): (a) a warm-up after which no step starts now raises ValueError, and the noisy warning counts measured tokens; (b) the CLI and simulate() reject negative --spec-k/--prefetch-extra/--prefetch, because Spec/Prefetch are always constructed and _as_prefetch(number) validates; (c) Spec.k becomes an int, and io_threads/lfu_samples too, with non-integral values rejected, warmup included; (d) calibrate() validates each point and names it; (e) Trace validates n_layers (0 or moe_layers..2^32-1); (f) a cache larger than the RAM left (the allocated slots, after the min/max clamps) makes Result.feasible False with an 'INFEASIBLE: cache' warning, flagged in every table; (g) SIMULATOR.md sec. 8.4 now says 1461 slots (23.9 GiB).
hypotheses_validated.evidence: tests: test_warmup_must_leave_a_measured_step, test_cli_rejects_bad_inputs_without_traceback (24 flag sets), test_simulate_rejects_bad_inputs (31 cases), test_integral_floats_are_normalised, test_calibrate_rejects_bad_measurements, test_trace_validates_n_layers, test_cache_beyond_free_ram_is_infeasible, test_prefetch_spec_forms_and_warning_boundaries.
